extracted.name: Chicken & dumplings
extracted.description: Ms.Kayla’s recipe and my personal touches to this yummy chicken & dumplings dish 🤩
instruction_lines: Add bone broth to pot once you get a rolling boil add your chicken and cook thoroughly.

Remove chicken, shred it & set it to the side. Pot should still be at medium heat. Add your 1 1/2 cup of heavy whipping cream, 1 can of cream of chicken, 2 bouillon cubes, paprika, onion powder, adobo all purpose, basil. All to taste except the can of cream of chicken & heavy whipping cream.
Buttermilk bisquit- flatten, cut into small pieces (they will expand when it’s in the pot) medium heat soft rolling bubbles.
Add hand shredded chicken and final touch of honey to balance the saltiness. Don’t add too much!
